parametrized_description: An accounting firm employs senior accountants at SeniorWage per week and junior accountants at JuniorWage per week. At least MinTotalAccountants accountants are needed, of whom at least MinSeniorAccountants must be senior. The number of senior accountants must be at least SeniorToJuniorRatio times the number of junior accountants. The total weekly wage bill must not exceed WageBillLimit. Minimize the weekly wage bill.

SeniorWage.description: Weekly wage of a senior accountant

JuniorWage.description: Weekly wage of a junior accountant

MinTotalAccountants.description: Minimum total number of accountants required

MinSeniorAccountants.description: Minimum number of senior accountants required

SeniorToJuniorRatio.description: Minimum ratio of senior to junior accountants

NumSenior.description: Number of senior accountants to employ

NumJunior.description: Number of junior accountants to employ

constraints.description: Total number of accountants must be at least MinTotalAccountants.
Number of senior accountants must be at least MinSeniorAccountants.
Number of senior accountants must be at least SeniorToJuniorRatio times the number of junior accountants.
Total weekly wage bill must not exceed WageBillLimit.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(SeniorWage * NumSenior + JuniorWage * NumJunior <= WageBillLimit, name="WageBill")

constraints.description: Number of accountants must be non-negative.

objective.description: Minimize the total weekly wage bill.
